chunks: We had prescribed in the Book of Psalms after the reminder, that the earth will be inherited by Our righteous servants.

key_terms.الذِّكْرِ: The Reminder (often referring to the Quran or divine message)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about who will inherit the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as a foundational proof for the concept of *Istila'* (inheritance of the earth) by the righteous, particularly linking the ultimate victory to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Mahdi. The phrase 'after the Dhikr' is interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as referring to the Torah, Gospel, and Quran, indicating that this promise was consistently affirmed across previous divine scriptures. It underscores the eschatological transition from worldly dominion to spiritual and physical stewardship by the *Abid al-Salihin*.
